report.summary: Chunk 1 of vendors.py: module docstring with design constraints, closed vocabularies, identity functions, and VendorReply/FloorRefusal dataclasses.
risks: PROMPT_DATA_NOTICE | low | Prompt injection mitigation via instruction to report finding; effectiveness depends on model compliance, not enforced by code.
model_family | medium | Heuristic over-merges model families; under-merging silently fakes independence but over-merging costs a seat.
actor_id | low | Uses bus.actor_id; if that function changes format, ids may drift unless this module is updated.
VendorReply.independence_class | medium | Always ('unknown','unknown') in this chunk; actual logic to set it is elsewhere.
FloorRefusal | low | rule/channel stored but never used in this chunk; match logic is elsewhere.
todos: Verify that bus.actor_id exists and matches ADR-010 format.
Verify that sensitivity.lane_for_host and secret_floor_rule are implemented.
Verify that tests/test_host_predicate.py exists and tests the predicate.
Ensure independence_class is populated by adapter code (not shown here).

claims.text: Every adapter here exposes the same shape -- ask(prompt, *, role, timeout_s, model=None) -> VendorReply
claims.why: No adapter class or ask method is defined in this chunk.

claims.text: This module produces EVIDENCE, never a decision. VendorReply carries no approve/reject/score/verdict/majority field and must never grow one
claims.why: VendorReply dataclass has no such fields; __init__ only checks status and lane.

claims.text: status here is a TRANSPORT status (did the bytes make the round trip), not a judgement
claims.why: STATUSES tuple defines transport outcomes; VendorReply.status is validated against it.

claims.text: The premise ... is refuted as follows ... (falsification protocol)
claims.why: The measurement and arms are described but not implemented in this chunk.

claims.text: Nothing here writes, edits, applies or promotes anything.
claims.why: No write operations (file I/O, subprocess spawn) are present in this chunk.

claims.text: Council profiles are deliberately NOT adapters.subprocess_adapter.RUNTIME_PROFILES
claims.why: RUNTIME_PROFILES is not defined in this chunk; no comparison possible.

claims.text: A reviewer must be a COMPLETION, NOT AN AGENT
claims.why: The docstring describes constraints; no agentic code is present in this chunk.

claims.text: every subprocess is spawned in a FRESH EMPTY TEMP DIRECTORY that is not the repo
claims.why: council_cwd is declared but not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: The secret floor runs PER FILE before any bytes leave the process
claims.why: floor_check is declared but not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: OLLAMA_HOST is NEVER set, mutated or inherited by anything in this module.
claims.why: No assignment or reference to OLLAMA_HOST in this chunk.

claims.text: the host is passed explicitly per call, and whether it counts as local is decided by sensitivity.lane_for_host
claims.why: lane_for_host is imported but not called in this chunk.

claims.text: codex and agy default to lane='untrusted'
claims.why: No adapter defaults are set in this chunk.

claims.text: Council records are NEVER an input to memory recall, and nothing in this module touches memstore.
claims.why: No import or reference to memstore in this chunk.

claims.text: STATUSES: tuple[str, ...] = (...) CLOSED -- an adapter may not invent a sixth.
claims.why: STATUSES is a tuple with five elements; no extension mechanism is present.

claims.text: None of these is a judgement about the reviewed work; 'ok' means the bytes came back, nothing more.
claims.why: VendorReply has no judgement fields; status is validated against STATUSES.

claims.text: UNAVAILABLE_REASONS: tuple[str, ...] = (...) Machine reasons -- never free prose
claims.why: UNAVAILABLE_REASONS is a tuple of fixed strings.

claims.text: DEFAULT_LOCAL_OLLAMA_HOST = 'http://127.0.0.1:11434' Not 'localhost': avoids the IPv6 (::1) miss on Windows
claims.why: The constant uses 127.0.0.1, not localhost.

claims.text: PROMPT_DATA_NOTICE = (...) Prepended to EVERY outbound prompt.
claims.why: The constant is defined but its usage (prepending to prompts) is not shown in this chunk.

claims.text: The mitigation is not a better delimiter -- it is that an injection attempt becomes a FINDING.
claims.why: No enforcement logic is present in this chunk.

claims.text: NO LOCAL-HOST TABLE HERE, ON PURPOSE. ... This module used to carry _LOCAL_HOSTS + _endpoint_host and disagreed with the shared predicate
claims.why: No local-host table is defined in this chunk.

claims.text: See tests/test_host_predicate.py, which fails if the table comes back.
claims.why: The test file is not in this chunk.

claims.text: A bare actor: 'claude' in a durable record is a defect
claims.why: actor_id function includes vendor and model; a bare vendor name would not match the output format.

claims.text: The FORMAT is delegated to bus.actor_id so the id on a transcript turn and the id on the reply that produced it cannot drift apart
claims.why: bus.actor_id is imported but its implementation is not in this chunk.

claims.text: The unit of independence is WEIGHTS, not endpoints.
claims.why: model_family strips tag and size/version tokens, merging models by base name.

claims.text: Heuristic and deliberately coarse -- it strips the tag (:7b) and any trailing size/version token, so it OVER-merges rather than under-merges.
claims.why: The function splits on ':', rsplit '/', then pops trailing tokens matching size/version patterns.

claims.text: VendorReply Deliberately carries NO approve/reject/pass/verdict/ok/score/confidence field
claims.why: VendorReply fields are vendor, actor, model, status, content, latency_s, reason, stderr, usage, independence_class, endpoint, cli_version, lane, local, withheld -- none are approve/reject/etc.

claims.text: reason: Machine reason from UNAVAILABLE_REASONS, or a secret-floor rule LABEL (never the matched bytes).
claims.why: The actual assignment of reason is not in this chunk.

claims.text: FloorRefusal: A secret-floor hit. Names the RULE, never the matched bytes.
claims.why: Fields are rule (str) and channel (str); no matched bytes field.

observations.what: VendorReply has no approve/reject fields; status is transport only.
STATUSES and LANES are closed tuples; validation in VendorReply.__post_init__.
model_family uses heuristic to merge model families; may over-merge.
actor_id depends on bus.actor_id; not defined in this chunk.
OLLAMA_HOST is not set or referenced in this chunk.
No write operations present; no subprocess spawn or file I/O.
RunResult class is incomplete; only header shown.
